english.title: Drugs - contravene travel restriction order - leave UK
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) left the United Kingdom at a time when you were prohibited from leaving it by a travel restriction order made under section 33 of the Criminal Justice and Police Act 2001
english.legislation: Contrary to section 36(1) of the Criminal Justice and Police Act 2001.

english.notes: A travel restriction order may be imposed on an offender convicted of a drug trafficking offence committed after 31st March 2002 for which a sentence of four years or more imprisonment was imposed (section 33 of the Criminal Justice and Police Act 2001).

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 5 years imprisonment and/or fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2022; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 282(2) and (3) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.

For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.
